description.p: Patchy is a fast image editor built around Photoshop's PSD and PSB formats: layers, groups, masks, clipping masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, editable text, shape layers, and Smart Objects with Smart Filters round-trip with Photoshop. It includes Photoshop-style painting, retouching, and selection tools (Object Selection among them), vector paths and warped text, 16 and 32-bit editing, Camera Raw, CMYK proofing and CMYK export for print, PDF and Affinity import, JPEG XL, palette-constrained pixel-art editing with exact indexed PNG/BMP export, nearly 400 G'MIC filters with live preview, and JavaScript scripting.

Patchy ist ein schneller Bildeditor rund um die Photoshop-Formate PSD und PSB: Ebenen, Gruppen, Masken, Schnittmasken, Einstellungsebenen, Ebenenstile, bearbeitbarer Text, Formebenen sowie Smart-Objekte mit Smartfiltern lassen sich mit Photoshop austauschen. Er bietet Mal-, Retusche- und Auswahlwerkzeuge im Photoshop-Stil (darunter die Objektauswahl), Vektorpfade und verkrümmten Text, Bearbeitung mit 16 und 32 Bit, Camera Raw, CMYK-Proof und CMYK-Export für den Druck, Import von PDF- und Affinity-Dateien, JPEG XL, palettengebundene Pixel-Art-Bearbeitung mit exaktem indiziertem PNG/BMP-Export, fast 400 G'MIC-Filter mit Live-Vorschau und Skripting mit JavaScript.

Patchy es un editor de imágenes rápido construido en torno a los formatos PSD y PSB de Photoshop: las capas, los grupos, las máscaras, las máscaras de recorte, las capas de ajuste, los estilos de capa, el texto editable, las capas de forma y los objetos inteligentes con filtros inteligentes se conservan al intercambiar archivos con Photoshop. Incluye herramientas de pintura, retoque y selección al estilo de Photoshop (entre ellas la Selección de objetos), trazados vectoriales y texto deformado, edición de 16 y 32 bits, Camera Raw, prueba de color CMYK y exportación CMYK para imprenta, importación de PDF y Affinity, JPEG XL, edición de pixel art limitada a una paleta con exportación exacta a PNG/BMP indexado, casi 400 filtros de G'MIC con vista previa en vivo y scripts en JavaScript.

Patchy est un éditeur d'images rapide conçu autour des formats PSD et PSB de Photoshop : les calques, groupes, masques, masques d'écrêtage, calques de réglage, styles de calque, textes modifiables, calques de forme et objets dynamiques avec filtres dynamiques font l'aller-retour avec Photoshop. Il propose des outils de peinture, de retouche et de sélection dans l'esprit de Photoshop (dont la sélection d'objet), des tracés vectoriels et du texte déformé, l'édition en 16 et 32 bits, Camera Raw, l'épreuvage CMJN et l'export CMJN pour l'impression, l'import de fichiers PDF et Affinity, le JPEG XL, une édition pixel art limitée à une palette avec un export exact en PNG/BMP indexé, près de 400 filtres G'MIC avec aperçu en direct et des scripts JavaScript.

Patchy è un editor di immagini veloce costruito attorno ai formati PSD e PSB di Photoshop: livelli, gruppi, maschere, maschere di ritaglio, livelli di regolazione, stili di livello, testo modificabile, livelli forma e oggetti avanzati con filtri avanzati si scambiano con Photoshop. Include strumenti di pittura, ritocco e selezione in stile Photoshop (compresa la selezione oggetto), tracciati vettoriali e testo alterato, modifica a 16 e 32 bit, Camera Raw, prova colori CMYK ed esportazione CMYK per la stampa, importazione di file PDF e Affinity, JPEG XL, modifica pixel art vincolata a una tavolozza con esportazione esatta in PNG/BMP indicizzato, quasi 400 filtri G'MIC con anteprima dal vivo e script JavaScript.

Patchy は Photoshop の PSD/PSB 形式を中心に設計された高速な画像エディタです。レイヤー、グループ、マスク、クリッピングマスク、調整レイヤー、レイヤースタイル、編集可能なテキスト、シェイプレイヤー、スマートフィルター付きのスマートオブジェクトを Photoshop と相互にやり取りできます。Photoshop 風のペイント、レタッチ、選択ツール（オブジェクト選択を含む）、ベクトルパスとワープテキスト、16 ビットと 32 ビットの編集、Camera Raw、印刷用の CMYK 校正と CMYK 書き出し、PDF と Affinity ファイルの読み込み、JPEG XL、正確なインデックス PNG/BMP 書き出しに対応したパレット制限付きのピクセルアート編集、ライブプレビュー付きの 400 近い G'MIC フィルター、JavaScript によるスクリプトを備えています。

Patchy는 Photoshop PSD 및 PSB 형식을 중심으로 설계된 빠른 이미지 편집기입니다. 레이어, 그룹, 마스크, 클리핑 마스크, 조정 레이어, 레이어 스타일, 편집 가능한 텍스트, 모양 레이어, 고급 필터가 적용된 고급 개체를 Photoshop과 주고받을 수 있습니다. Photoshop 방식의 페인팅, 리터칭, 선택 도구(개체 선택 포함), 벡터 패스와 뒤틀기 텍스트, 16비트 및 32비트 편집, Camera Raw, 인쇄용 CMYK 교정과 CMYK 내보내기, PDF 및 Affinity 파일 가져오기, JPEG XL, 정확한 인덱스 PNG/BMP 내보내기를 지원하는 팔레트 기반 픽셀 아트 편집, 실시간 미리 보기를 지원하는 400개 가까운 G'MIC 필터, JavaScript 스크립팅을 제공합니다.

Patchy to szybki edytor obrazów oparty na formatach PSD i PSB programu Photoshop. Warstwy, grupy, maski, maski przycinające, warstwy dopasowania, style warstw, edytowalny tekst, warstwy kształtów oraz obiekty inteligentne z filtrami inteligentnymi można wymieniać z programem Photoshop. Zawiera narzędzia do malowania, retuszu i zaznaczania w stylu Photoshopa (w tym zaznaczanie obiektu), ścieżki wektorowe i wypaczony tekst, edycję 16- i 32-bitową, Camera Raw, podgląd CMYK i eksport CMYK do druku, import plików PDF i Affinity, JPEG XL, edycję pixel artu ograniczoną do palety z dokładnym eksportem do indeksowanych formatów PNG/BMP, prawie 400 filtrów G'MIC z podglądem na żywo oraz skrypty JavaScript.

O Patchy é um editor de imagens rápido desenvolvido em torno dos formatos PSD e PSB do Photoshop: camadas, grupos, máscaras, máscaras de corte, camadas de ajuste, estilos de camada, texto editável, camadas de forma e objetos inteligentes com filtros inteligentes podem ser trocados com o Photoshop. Inclui ferramentas de pintura, retoque e seleção no estilo do Photoshop (entre elas a Seleção de objeto), demarcadores vetoriais e texto deformado, edição em 16 e 32 bits, Camera Raw, prova de cores CMYK e exportação CMYK para impressão, importação de PDF e Affinity, JPEG XL, edição de pixel art limitada à paleta com exportação exata para PNG/BMP indexado, quase 400 filtros do G'MIC com visualização ao vivo e scripts em JavaScript.

Patchy: быстрый редактор изображений на основе форматов Photoshop PSD и PSB. Слои, группы, маски, обтравочные маски, корректирующие слои, стили слоёв, редактируемый текст, слои-фигуры и смарт-объекты со смарт-фильтрами сохраняются при обмене файлами с Photoshop. Редактор включает инструменты рисования, ретуши и выделения в стиле Photoshop (в том числе выделение объектов), векторные контуры и деформированный текст, редактирование в 16 и 32 битах, Camera Raw, цветопробу CMYK и экспорт в CMYK для печати, импорт файлов PDF и Affinity, JPEG XL, редактирование пиксельной графики с ограничением палитры и точным экспортом в индексированные PNG/BMP, почти 400 фильтров G'MIC с предпросмотром в реальном времени и скрипты на JavaScript.

Patchy 是一款围绕 Photoshop PSD 和 PSB 格式打造的快速图像编辑器：图层、组、蒙版、剪贴蒙版、调整图层、图层样式、可编辑文字、形状图层以及带智能滤镜的智能对象可在与 Photoshop 交换文件时保留。它提供 Photoshop 风格的绘画、修饰和选择工具（包括对象选择）、矢量路径和变形文字、16 位与 32 位编辑、Camera Raw、用于印刷的 CMYK 校样和 CMYK 导出、PDF 和 Affinity 文件导入、JPEG XL、受调色板约束并可精确导出索引 PNG/BMP 的像素画编辑、近 400 个带实时预览的 G'MIC 滤镜，以及 JavaScript 脚本。

Patchy 是一款以 Photoshop PSD 和 PSB 格式為核心的快速影像編輯器：圖層、群組、遮色片、剪裁遮色片、調整圖層、圖層樣式、可編輯文字、形狀圖層以及具備智慧型濾鏡的智慧型物件可在與 Photoshop 交換檔案時保留。它提供 Photoshop 風格的繪圖、修飾和選取工具（包括物件選取）、向量路徑和彎曲文字、16 位元與 32 位元編輯、Camera Raw、用於印刷的 CMYK 校樣和 CMYK 匯出、PDF 和 Affinity 檔案匯入、JPEG XL、受調色盤限制並可精確匯出索引 PNG/BMP 的像素藝術編輯、近 400 個具即時預覽的 G'MIC 濾鏡，以及 JavaScript 指令碼。

The Perspective Crop tool, Image > Trim, and tools that work with no document open

Shape tools: width 0 means no stroke, Ctrl and Shift modifiers, tidier create dialogs
Crop overlay and options, Pick tool sample choices and loupe, a Hand tool options bar
A faster Liquify with more brush options and undo, and faster Warp on large files
The Polygonal Lasso, Merge Visible, a New Layer dialog and Background layer rules
Consistent options bars, HDR AVIF and high-bit-depth HEIF at full depth, Wayland color picking
Photoshop adjustment layers such as Channel Mixer, Black & White, Color Lookup, Vibrance and Selective Color render and edit
Many more Photoshop Smart Filters render and edit, and unsupported ones can be hidden or deleted
Free Transform Skew, Distort and Perspective, and clearer Path Select and Direct Select roles
Layer styles listed in the Layers panel, plus CMYK PSD, lock, color label and metadata handling
A pixel grid at high zoom, and the last tool and its options remembered
Artboards, and a PDF import that brings pages in as folders with mode, bit depth and page order options

A Missing Fonts dialog and safer handling of text whose font is not installed
The status bar shows the document's size, resolution, color mode and bit depth

Warp stays responsive on large images and fast brush strokes follow the pointer
Linux: the system title bar by default under a global menu, and the desktop's own file dialogs in the AppImage
AVIF, JPEG 2000, Radiance HDR and OpenEXR open and save; animated AVIF and animated PNG open as layers; JPEG-compressed TIFF opens
Paint strokes keep only their changed pixels in the undo history
Image rotate 180 and flips; layer rotate right, left and 180
Marquee drags stop at the image edge, with a readout pill beside the pointer
Color picker: a 48-color Basic palette, Add Custom Color, percentages for Sat and Val, Alt+click eyedropper for the background color
Tool palette overflow and icon fixes, Ctrl+K for Preferences, options-bar labels without colons
Linux: Patchy's own frameless window chrome with a system title bar option, HEIC through the system libheif, Wayland maximize and screen color picking fixes
A compact color well pinned to the bottom of the tool palette, with Quick Mask beside it
Shape and text drags can start outside the canvas
The options bar keeps one row until a tool needs two
Pen tool: no handle trails when moving several anchors, and masks stay targeted through undo
SVG import keeps strokes that are more opaque than their fill
The Open dialog remembers its format filter, lists HEIF only where supported, and names files it cannot read
Short screens keep the side panels on-screen, and Wayland menus open in place at any interface scale
G'MIC Filter Library: about 390 built-in G'MIC filters with a live canvas preview
CMYK for print: working profile, CMYK picker and readouts, soft proofing with plates, CMYK export
JPEG XL open and save
An official AppImage with one-click self-update
Filter > Last Filter repeats the last filter with the same settings
The Background layer works like Photoshop's, and Flatten Image was added
Wayland: side panels stay docked, fixing a stuck mouse after dragging one out
Object Selection: an optional High Quality model, downloaded on request, finds objects much more accurately
Dragging a box with Object Selection analyzes just that area for sharper edges
Copy Merged keeps the shape of the selection, and filters and adjustments blend soft selection edges
AI assistants connected to Patchy report when it has been updated or a new release is out
Object Selection tool: drag a box or click an object to select it, using a model that runs on the CPU
File > File Info: view, edit and strip image metadata, kept on save
Move tool arrow-key nudges work with a physical keyboard on every platform
PSD compatibility: native CMYK compositing, native color spaces kept in CMYK, grayscale and 16-bit saves, and closer knockout, stroke, duotone and noise gradient rendering
Saves and document recovery hold up better against crashes and power loss

Text inside shapes, saved as native Photoshop area text

Crop tool: Delete Cropped Pixels (on by default) and Delete Off-Canvas Layers options; the Crop commands use the Crop tool's box
Pressing Alt mid-drag draws a marquee or crop box from the center
The Shape Appearance dialog opens sized to all of its rows
Crop tool: frames the canvas, adopts the selection, and has a Size mode for an exact width and height
Move tool: Alt-drag duplicates the layer and Ctrl+click selects the layer under the pointer
Zoom steps along fixed zoom levels, and 100% is one document pixel per screen pixel on scaled displays
Changing the foreground color recolors the selected shape
Opens Bitmap, Indexed, Duotone, Lab and Multichannel PSDs, and adds the Exposure adjustment layer
Closing a modified document offers Save, Don't Save, and Cancel
Patchy now updates through flatpak update and the software center, from a signed repository
Open from Clipboard: File menu command that opens the copied image as a new document
Clicking a palette swatch recolors the selected text and shape layers
Type tool: press on a text layer and drag to select text in one gesture
Fixed a freeze on KDE when a drag crossed the layer action buttons
Edit shape appearance and layer styles across selected layers, with mixed-value indicators, live previews, and one undo step per edit
Merge selected vectors into one editable vector layer, with a preview and a choice of what happens to layer effects
Fixed caps on inside and outside dashed vector strokes, and pattern thumbnails in Shape Appearance
Animated WebP import and export, with frame timing preview, lossless output, partial transparency, and loop counts
Four more interface languages: Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Polish, and Korean
PSD compatibility: fixed legacy gradient fills and empty layer masks
Clearer notices when an installed font cannot draw the text
